title: Sounds X Waystones
description: Replaces break, fall, hit, place, and step sound ids for Waystones mod.
body:
This resource pack uses [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/project/ZouiUX7t) mod sound definitions to replace the default sounds of many blocks and items, allowing for more immersive gameplay experience.

Replaces break, fall, hit, place, and step sound ids for:

[Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones)
- All Waystone variants besides prismarine and blackstone
- All Sharestone variants
- All Portstone variants
- Warp Plate
- All Warp Stone variants
- Warp Dust
- Dormant Shard
- All Scroll variants
